# Addy Osmani web-quality — vendor hub

This vendor has no single master skill; it ships 6 tools, each a command of its own.
`/design-tools:osmani <tool> <target>` runs that tool; `/design-tools:osmani` alone lists them.

**Request:** $ARGUMENTS

## Do

- If the request starts with one of the tool names below, run it exactly as its own command would
  (`commands/<command>.md`): resolve with `bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/resolve.sh" <tool>`,
  load (`load: skill` → Skill tool; `load: read` → Read and follow, base first), brand contract before
  any write, run, report what changed. Read-only tools change nothing.
- If it names none of them, print the list below with one line each and ask which one — do not guess,
  and do not run two.

## Tools

- `/design-tools:osmani-accessibility` — Full WCAG 2.2 accessibility pass — POUR, conformance level, fixes. (writes)
- `/design-tools:osmani-core-web-vitals` — Diagnoses and fixes LCP, INP and CLS by name. (writes)
- `/design-tools:osmani-performance` — Cuts page weight and load time: payload, critical path, fonts, images, caching. (writes)
- `/design-tools:osmani-seo` — On-page SEO: meta, structured data, sitemap, robots, headings, internal links. (writes)
- `/design-tools:osmani-best-practices` — Security headers, CSP and modern platform practices. (writes)
- `/design-tools:osmani-web-quality-audit` — Umbrella audit across performance, a11y, SEO and best practices; names the worst axis; read-only. (read-only)

Vendor card: `wiki/vendors/osmani.md` · vendor contract: Metrics and compliance. `web-quality-audit` first when the worst axis is unknown; the named skill when it is.
